description: The plot illustrates the relative change across different layers, comparing various configurations. The x-axis represents the layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) on a categorical scale. The y-axis represents the relative change in percentage, ranging from -15% to 5% on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot displays four lines: the yellow line with circle markers, representing 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit', starts at 0% and remains relatively stable, ending at around 0%; the red line with square markers, representing 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit', begins at 0%, decreases to around -2% at Layer13-20, and then slightly increases to approximately -1% at Layer29-32; the light blue line with circle markers, representing 'RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit', starts at around -1%, decreases to about -6% at Layer13-20, and then increases to roughly -1% at Layer29-32; the dark blue line with square markers, representing 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit', begins at around -2%, sharply decreases to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -1% at Layer29-32. All lines are solid.
